env_text:
# Vyomi: AWS
# Honored by current AWS CLI v2 and SDKs; older SDKs need endpoint_url / endpointOverride in code.
AWS_ENDPOINT_URL=http://127.0.0.1:9000
AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID=test
AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY=test
AWS_DEFAULT_REGION=us-east-1
AWS_REGION=us-east-1
# Stops AWS CLI v2's pager swallowing short output.
AWS_PAGER=""
notes: One endpoint serves every AWS service: the simulator routes by SigV4 scope / X-Amz-Target / Query Action.
S3 is path-style: set forcePathStyle=true (JS v3) or s3={'addressing_style':'path'} (boto3) if virtual-host addressing fails.

cli.notes: This simulator accepts AWS-style request/response shapes locally across S3, IAM, EC2, Lambda, VPC, RDS, SQS, DynamoDB, and API Gateway.

help: Use BaseEndpoint to point the client at the simulator.
Configure the SDK client with endpointOverride=http://127.0.0.1:9000
Use the same service names and request models as AWS SDK v2.
Pass endpoint to each service client constructor.
Use endpoint_url to point boto3 clients at the simulator.
All standard boto3 service clients work with the simulator endpoint.

terraform.hcl:
provider "aws" {
  region                      = "us-east-1"
  access_key                  = "test"
  secret_key                  = "test"
  skip_credentials_validation = true
  skip_requesting_account_id  = true
  skip_metadata_api_check     = true
  s3_use_path_style           = true
  endpoints {
    s3       = "http://127.0.0.1:9000"
    sqs      = "http://127.0.0.1:9000"
    dynamodb = "http://127.0.0.1:9000"
    lambda   = "http://127.0.0.1:9000"
    iam      = "http://127.0.0.1:9000"
    ec2      = "http://127.0.0.1:9000"
    rds      = "http://127.0.0.1:9000"
    kms      = "http://127.0.0.1:9000"
    sns      = "http://127.0.0.1:9000"
    secretsmanager = "http://127.0.0.1:9000"
  }
}

variables.note: Honored by current AWS CLI v2 and SDKs; older SDKs need endpoint_url / endpointOverride in code.
